BiblicalUsage: Katan is the father of Johanan, who came up with Ezra from Babylon: of the sons of Azgad, Johanan the son of Hakkatan. With him came an hundred and ten males.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the name on the list as the record of a family that came home, and the record is enough.
